featured_reviews.review_text: I have been here for the first time. I think this clinic should also accept payment by credit card as it is the norm at the other consultants clinic. Consultancy fees is ₹300 for the first visit and ₹200 for every subsequent visit. The doctor here listens you well and may order one or more tests or prescribe medicines. This doctor doesn't have any specialised knowledge about ENT.
